apps.zohoBooksGoodToKnow: Sena baya maye gurbin Zoho Books a matsayin tsarin lissafi. Gyara a Zoho Books baya canza zama ko ragowa a cikin Sena. Haɗi ba ya fitar da tarihi kai tsaye.
apps.zohoBooksHowCreate: Takardar kudi sabuwa → an fitar zuwa Zoho Books
apps.zohoBooksHowUpdate: Biyan da aka tabbatar → daidaita biyan zuwa Zoho Books idan an kunna
apps.zohoBooksPaymentAccountHelp: Zaɓi asusun tsabar kuɗi/banki na Zoho Books da ke karɓar biyan da aka daidaita. Bar shi don amfani da tsohon ƙungiyar.
apps.zohoBooksOrgsEmpty: Babu ƙungiyoyin Zoho Books da aka dawo da su don wannan asusun.
apps.zohoBooksOrgsEmptyHelp: Ƙungiyoyin Zoho Invoice sun bambanta da Zoho Books. Ƙirƙiri ko haɓaka ƙungiya a Zoho Books, sa'an nan sabunta wannan shafi. Haɗin Sena yana nan.
apps.zohoBooksOrganizationHelp: Zaɓi ƙungiyar Zoho Books da za ta karɓi abokan hulɗa da takardun kuɗi da aka daidaita.
apps.zohoBooksSyncInvoicesHelp: Idan an kunna, sabbin takardun kuɗin Sena za su daidaita zuwa Zoho Books a bango. Ba a fitar da tsofaffin takardu ta atomatik ba.
